body:
Ever lose an hour hunting down one thing Taylor wore? We built the fix. That willow-era Jennifer Behr headpiece now sits behind a single credited retailer link — real match, no detective work. Her look, not the product 🤍

longlivets.com/?mode=merch&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch
mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift performing the reputation set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a black snake-motif costume under dark green stage lighting.
why: X sibling of the 09-18 shop-the-look example (see the IG item's why for the willow-look / Jennifer Behr Priscilla tiara sourcing from evermore.mjs: the gown sold out, the tiara/headpiece is the live tappable piece). Written first as its own post: the problem, the fix, the one real piece, the disclaimer, the link. Disclaimer 'her look, not the product' verbatim; /?mode=merch verified. Re-angled after two cross-post-copy fails (93% then 85%): the X now leads on the fan pain-point ('lose an hour hunting') and drops the IG's shared phrases (Seen on Taylor / tap / tiara / wore) for near-disjoint vocabulary, clearing the <80% gate; first five words diverge from both the IG sibling and 09-17's X, and 'Ever lose' is not the banned 'ever wonder' opener. Media: credited Taylor photo, a different era from the IG evermore tile (reputation, an unused-preferred era this fortnight); X site-screens prohibited; photoEra unset (launch). Weighted length under 270. Launch-arc = share-hook exempt. Lyric-free. rulesChecked [].

critique.rationale: A one-breath proof of the merch surface — the fan pain-point, the exact willow-era Jennifer Behr piece it links to, the honest disclaimer, structurally unlike its IG sibling. Photo is a credited on-brand Taylor tour tile rather than the look itself, so it earns its place loosely.
